shortDescription: Mega capacity 5.0 cu. ft. washer and 7.4 cu. ft. electric dryer in single unit WashTower™ design with ezDispense® automatic detergent dispenser, Center Control® Panel LCD display with touch buttons and Smart Pairing.

features.text: Built-In Intel Takes Out the Guesswork
Forget about sorting or choosing cycles- built-in sensors use AI technology to detect fabric texture, soil level, and load size, then customize wash/dry motions and temps.
The LG WashTower™'s top-of-the-line innovations—TurboWash™360°, Allergiene™ wash cycle and TurboSteam™ technology deliver the advanced cleaning performance you need.
LG's ezDispense® (for 8-12 lb. loads) auto dispenses the right amount of detergent and fabric softener- skipping refills for up to 18 cycles. Even get alerts on your smartphone for refills.

Backed by a 10-year limited warranty, the LG Direct Drive Motor delivers quiet peace of mind with every load. Fewer moving parts means less noise and vibration, greater stability and durable performance you can depend on for years to come. Ultra-quiet operation makes it a great fit for second floor locations and smaller spaces such as condos or near bedrooms.
Go Big to Save Time and Get More Done
With 5.0 cu. ft. in the washer and 7.4 cu. ft. in the dryer, you can fit big loads of towels, jeans or a king-size comforter, for big time savings every week.
All You Want in Half the Space
Reinvent how you do laundry with room to add a sink, a folding table or organized storage—all with a sleek, streamlined look in half the space1 plus easy-reach controls
Tastefully hidden from view until you tap the power button, LG's intuitive Center Control® LCD panel shows each setting, helpful prompts, and status updates.
Real tempered glass doors provide a sleek, stylish look that also resists shock and scratches. Chrome rim complements the doors and enhance the premium feel.
A Smarter Home Starts with the LG ThinkQ® App

The ThinQ app offers control and convenience for smart LG appliances to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home. Manage and monitor your WashTower remotely, track and download cycles, connect with Google or Alexa voice assistants, and more. ThinQ Care appliances send usage, maintenance, and diagnostic alerts to notify you of potential issues and hazards like clogged dryer ducts. ThinQ UP appliances receive software updates for new features and enhancements
